hook: Federal investigators just exposed nearly $490 million in tax fraud across America.

sections.voiceover: Federal investigators just exposed nearly $490 million in tax fraud across America.

How did the United States Department of Justice Fraud Division, IRS, and IRS-CI conduct their first-ever National Tax Enforcement Surge? Why did thirty-five U.S. attorneys' offices team up with internal revenue investigators?
Department of Justice prosecutors returned 23 actions with new charges against 31 defendants.
The United States Department of Justice prosecuted 76 people linked to federal revenue losses.
Seventy-six defendants faced federal charges in the surge.
